tests.name: Local chapter and page override a stale server chapter without using latest publication metadata
Remote chapter history never establishes a precise page even when raw input claims one
A position without local provenance cannot display a claimed page
A favorite with no history is unknown even when its publication is complete
Completing a chapter keeps the comic in known reading history
An incomplete local anchor wins over a stale complete chapter flag
Chapter completion from catalog metadata remains useful without a native anchor
History without chapter identity is known history with an unavailable position
A chapter ID without catalog metadata is not presented as a chapter number
An empty catalog has an unknown reading state
A catalog reading marker can identify a chapter without guessing from publication order
Completed earlier chapters prove history without selecting an arbitrary continuation
Invalid page values are omitted instead of being rounded or defaulted to page one
Missing or invalid totals retain only the trustworthy page number
A page outside the known matching snapshot is not displayed as a valid ratio
A retained snapshot page never uses the current snapshot page total
A missing snapshot identity keeps the page without claiming a matching total
Legacy extra fields retain a precise local chapter and numeric page strings
An untitled chapter can show a local page without turning an identity into a title
Publication-only labels remain independent from reading history
Actual catalog favorites do not become unread and remote history stays chapter-only
Actual catalog native progress survives a newer server hint and matches descriptor page count
